player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Garage and Playroom, repeatedly going north and then south. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to continue the same pattern instead of exploring other rooms. Next time, I will pay closer attention to the available directions in each room and try to visit rooms that I haven't been to before. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead of sticking to the same pattern. I will also make sure to keep track of the rooms I've visited to avoid revisiting them unnecessarily.
